acceptance_criteria: A config-backed allowlist controls which Cloud notebooks are ledgered and OCRed; non-allowlisted notebooks are ignored by ingest and read contracts.
Ledger storage persists notebook revisions, stable page identifiers, content hashes, page order, OCR cache metadata, and change events for added, updated, removed, and reordered pages.
Ingest compares each Cloud snapshot to the latest ledger state and calls OCR only for pages whose stable ID is new or whose content hash changed.
Read contracts support explicit cursor reads and per-agent named cursors, return cached OCR/page metadata without Cloud fetches, and advance cursors only when requested.
Write contracts require a base notebook revision or equivalent ledger token and fail closed with no upload when the Cloud/ledger state has advanced.
CLI, API, and event-facing paths expose Pydantic/Instructor-style structured errors with code, message, retryability, suggested_action, details, and correlation identifiers where available.
Existing uploader behavior remains intact: apply/S3 PUT/finish upload flow, dry-run protections, backup expectations, stale-auth guidance, and no mutation on failed preflight.
Focused unit tests, integration tests with mocked Cloud/OCR/uploader boundaries, ruff, and final non-integration pytest suite pass.
Preexisting dirty files outside the approved touch set are not modified except by explicit human approval.
end_state.contract: The paia-supernote repo exposes a durable Supernote Cloud change ledger and agent-facing read/write contracts backed by SQLite/Pydantic models: configured allowlisted notebooks are snapshotted by stable page IDs and content hashes, page changes are recorded as added/updated/removed/reordered, only new or changed pages are OCRed, agents can read cached page/OCR state through explicit and per-agent cursors, write routes reject stale base revisions before upload, and CLI/API/event surfaces return structured actionable errors without weakening existing safe upload behavior.
out_of_scope: Building a new Supernote organizer UI or broad automation app.
Changing native Supernote page move semantics beyond the approved read/write contract hardening.
Adding generated summaries into target .note files.
Changing dependency pins or uv.lock unless an existing command deterministically updates it for this scoped work.
Live Cloud writes during tests; integration tests must mock Cloud and uploader boundaries unless a human explicitly authorizes a live dry run.
